follow_ups.title: Structural fan rotor: a published rotating blade or bladed disc read, recorded and compared
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. A published case of a rotating blade or a bladed disc with its natural frequencies (measured, or a benchmark solution) is read, and its geometry, material and values are recorded with their place in the source as a fragment under docs/reference-data.d; the solid solver reproduces those frequencies at rest and at speed within a band registered before the run from the stated uncertainty of the source; a source that cannot be obtained is recorded as not obtained and the item stays partial. Milestone fan-structure, headline.

follow_ups.title: Fan rotor at speed by a cyclic sector: the Campbell table of the bladed hub against the full rotor
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. One sector of the bladed hub of F-406 at registered speeds from rest to the registered maximum, with stress stiffening and spin softening and, as a second table, with the Coriolis term: for every harmonic index 0 to Z/2 the sector frequencies equal those of the full rotor on the coarse mesh within 1e-6 (heavy record), at rest they have the bits of the sector of F-406, and every crossing of the engine orders is listed with its nodal diameter. Milestone fan-structure, headline.
